setupGuide.title: Connect Yampi with API credentials
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: Sign in to the Yampi admin panel for the store you want to connect. You will need the store Alias, User Token, and User Secret Key from that account.

steps.title: Open your API credentials in Yampi
steps.description: In Yampi, open Perfil and then Credenciais de API to view the credentials for your account.

steps.title: Copy the store Alias, User Token, and User Secret Key
steps.description: Copy the Alias, User Token, and User Secret Key shown on that page. These three values are required for this connection.

steps.title: Paste the values into the connection form
steps.description: Return to the connection form, paste the Alias, User Token, and User Secret Key into their matching fields, then save or test the connection.
